title: One-page PRD: free-delivery progress message
context: After discovery, the team agrees to show shoppers **how far they are from free delivery** in the basket (and in the mini-basket). The pilot is on **Drogisterij Prijs**; the group wants it reusable for the other brands. Write the one-page PRD before refinement.

data.title: Drogisterij Prijs facts
rows: Sometimes free delivery on all orders

task: Fill in the one-page PRD. Keep each section short.

parts.label: Goal, metric and guardrails

parts.label: Out of scope

parts.prompt: Numbered, testable behaviours. Include special cases.

Real risks with mitigations; staged rollout with flag/test

hints: Start with the numbers: 41% of baskets are within €5 and 46% of orders are already above the threshold.
For functional requirements, walk through the basket: below the threshold, exactly at it, above it, basket changes, free-delivery weekend, Click & Collect.

Key items: threshold and fee configurable per brand and currency; message in NL/FR; no extra page weight; tracking event; risk: wrong message during promos. Rollout: DP behind a flag with an A/B test, then CC and MP.
modelAnswer:
**Problem:** 41% of Drogisterij Prijs baskets are within €5 of free delivery, but shoppers don't see how close they are until checkout.

**Goal, metric, guardrails:** More shoppers reach free delivery by adding an item. Orders above the threshold from **46% → 52% within 6 weeks**. Guardrails: basket→order conversion and margin per order stable.

**Users:** All DP shoppers with a home-delivery basket, mobile first (72%).

**In scope:** Progress message in the basket and the mini-basket; DP web (NL/FR).

**Out of scope:** Product suggestions to fill the gap; app; other brands (phase 2).

**Functional requirements**
1. Below the threshold: show "Add €X more for free delivery" with a progress bar.
2. At or above the threshold: show "You get free delivery".
3. The message updates instantly when items are added, removed or quantities change.
4. During a free-delivery promotion, show the promotion message instead.
5. Not shown for Click & Collect-only baskets (always free).
6. Threshold, fee and currency configurable per brand in the back office.

**Non-functional:** No measurable impact on LCP; NL/FR copy; WCAG 2.1 AA (text, not only colour); tracking event when the message is shown and when the threshold is crossed.

**Risks:** Wrong message during promos → rule 4 plus tests. Shoppers add cheap items, so margin falls → monitor the margin guardrail.

**Rollout:** DP behind a feature flag, 50/50 A/B test for 4 weeks; then CC (£) and MP.
commonMistakes: Hard-coding €20 instead of making it configurable per brand
Requirements like "the message should be clear and nice"
